fields.gap: Advisory crimp is replaced by NASA CR-1457 equations 6.2-3 through 6.2-6. Sourced cores stay on the moderate branch. Kc trims the buckling safety factor to between 0.863720643326 and 0.991105457684 of the MAINLINE-007 value.
fields.direction: A core shear modulus below about 2.45 MPa would enter the crimping branch. None of the sourced moduli do.
fields.effect: P2-E with Plascore at 16 kg/m3 falls from 0.233885578993 to 0.227959198328. Yield is unchanged and still larger.
